suggestions.title: Terminal shell setting
suggestions.body: Pick the shell terminal openers start: cmd, PowerShell, pwsh, or the Windows Terminal default profile (wt -p). Today it is always cmd.

suggestions.title: Split direction for panes
suggestions.body: panes layout uses wt auto split. Add auto, vertical, horizontal (split-pane -V/-H).

suggestions.title: Default opener setting
suggestions.body: Selector preselects Explorer (DEFAULT_APP_KEY in interactive.js). Make the fallback opener for shortcuts without their own opener a setting.

suggestions.title: Custom openers in Settings
suggestions.body: Manage config.json apps (cursor, sublime, ...) from the web Settings tab instead of upex app or hand-editing.

suggestions.title: WebStorm path in Settings
suggestions.body: Edit config.webstormPath from Settings, with a found/not-found check like upex doctor.

suggestions.title: upex config get/set
suggestions.body: CLI for settings (upex config set terminalLayout tabs), so they work without the TUI or web UI and in scripts.

suggestions.title: Default sort and view
suggestions.body: Persist the start view and sort (most used vs A to Z) in config so the selector and web UI share it; the web keeps sort only in localStorage today.
